parameters.content:
PURPOSE
Create proportionate recommendations that validate uncertain diagnoses before intervention.

OWNER
GRETEL TRACK B

INPUT CONTRACT
Accumulated payload with diagnoses[] and findings[]

OUTPUT CONTRACT
Accumulated payload plus recommendations[] conforming to recommendation.schema.json

STATUS
Phase 2B repository-ready. Inactive by default. No credentials. Deterministic fixture path; no Python execution.

VISIBLE PATH
Diagnosis -> validation required?
YES -> discovery/validation action
NO -> improvement action
Mission + proportionality gate -> structured recommendation
Journey before technology is enforced.
